name: East Brunswick Youth Council
what_you_do: Join social events, meetings and service projects with other East Brunswick high schoolers. You build leadership skills too.
who_can_apply: East Brunswick residents in grades 9 to 12.
pay_detail: Membership dues are $40 per school year.
deadline_text: No closing date posted. Registration is on the Volunteer Matrix site.
how_to_apply: Sign up on the Volunteer Matrix site. The page links to it. Email ebyouthcouncil@eastbrunswick.org.
notes: Run with the Township Division of Recreation and Community Services. The page also links to a membership guide for 2025-2026.
